basic_steps: Stand in place with feet together and arms at sides.
Extend the left leg to the side while raising both arms above the head in rhythm.
Extend the right leg to the side while raising both arms above the head in rhythm.
Repeat the sequence until the song ends.
teaching.level_notes: Extremely simple; suitable for beginners and children.
